Explore Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan with us as we discover the city’s local life, famous landmarks and food!
We explored the colourful Osh Bazaar, one of Bishkek’s most popular local markets.
From busy market lanes to delicious Samsa and local Kyrgyz food, it was a great experience!
We also visited the famous Ala-Too Square and Manas Monument.
Our city tour included Jash Gvardiya Boulevard, Molodaya Gvardiya Monument and Bishkek Park.
We also saw the Jogorku Kenesh (Kyrgyzstan Parliament Building) from outside.
